name: Gaussian Avatars
definition: A method that trains a FLAME model of the bust, associating each triangle with a Gaussian optimized for the scene but constrained to remain within its corresponding triangle.
summary: Gaussian Avatars reconstructs photorealistic, animatable head avatars by anchoring 3D Gaussians to a parametric FLAME mesh, optimizing ellipsoid parameters directly while enforcing geometric constraints for high-fidelity rendering and relighting.
